key.description: The key a melodic loop or take is in. Optional.

kind.description: `oneShot`: a single hit or note, played from a key. `loop`: a whole number of beats meant to repeat. `recording`: a longer take. Optional: absent says nothing of how it is meant to be used.

tags.description: Freely created tags, lower-cased on write.

audio.description: The recording, in this record's own account.

beats.description: How many beats a loop lasts, where `tempo` alone would leave it to rounding. Optional.

tempo.description: The tempo it was played at, in beats per minute from 20 to 999, as decimal text, from which a clip can be warped to an arrangement's. Optional: absent where it has none.

seconds.description: How long it lasts, in seconds, as decimal text, so a listing can say so without fetching it.

rootNote.description: The note a one-shot was recorded at, as a MIDI note number, so a key plays it at its own pitch. Optional.

main.description: A sample, held in its creator's own repository.

description: A recording published to be found and used: a one-shot, a loop or a longer take, with what is known of its time and pitch. A recording used only inside an arrangement is a blob of that arrangement and needs no record; this is for sharing one.
